question: Rajaram was the leader of which of the following revolts against the Mughals?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jat.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__ Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rajaram **was the leader of the **Jat revolt **against the **Mughals,** which took place in the early **18th century**. 
 
• The Jat uprising was mainly a response to the **oppressive policies** of the Mughal Empire, which had caused widespread discontent among the Jat **peasants and soldiers.**
 
• Rajaram was a** Jat chieftain** who led the rebellion and managed to capture several Mughal forts and cities, including** Agra and Mathura.**
 
• However, the Jat revolt was eventually suppressed by the Mughals, and Rajaram was captured and **executed in 1707**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Satnami **was a religious sect that rebelled against the Mughals in the late **17th century.**

 
 
• In **1657, Birbhan** established the first Satnamis, a group of homeowners and mendicants in **Narnaul, eastern Punjab.**
 
• They were subdued by** Aurangzeb's army in 1672** when they disobeyed him.
 
 
 
• A clan of Rajputs is the **Bundela.**
 
 
• They gained notoriety in **1545 **when they defeated **Sher Shah of Sur, the Afghan ruler,** who was slain during a siege of their stronghold at Kalinjar.
 
 
 
• The **Munda people** are an ethnic group from the Indian subcontinent who speak **Austraasiatic languages. **
 
 
• They are native speakers of** Mundari.**
